proposed_capability: Turn opted-in, independently attributed player gameplay choices and measured outcomes into reusable contextual advisory judgments through the existing host listener.
player_save_control_impact: No raw desktop inputs, focus, game effects, save access, transmission, or new background provider. Player presence retains yield and game-ineligible evidence cannot grant an effect permit.
expected_outcome: Player control causes yield as before while a consenting session learns only after a distinct, attributable outcome. A later fresh idle observation may receive a safely bounded contextual hint.
negative_tests: Unknown/foreign foreground and non-player choices cannot seed a demonstration.
Mismatched run/actor/household, reused captures and an unverified result cannot count toward support.
Duplicate and conflicting outcomes cannot inflate support or overwrite a valid model.
A positive outcome with material need harm or historical harmful evidence cannot promote unsafe advice.
An opted-out listener or player-owned queue cannot use the model.
rollback_path: Revert the isolated branch or merged PR and deactivate the opted-in session. The local bounded dist store creates no game artifacts; manual reviewed learner and control authority stay intact.
unresolved_unknowns: Installed exact-build native decision and independent outcome adapter; real gameplay utility and player control replay on the authorized Windows host.
decision_rationale: The current listener already participates in every bounded tandem tick while the player owns control. Reuse it plus the reviewed learner's scoring while retaining separate demonstrated provenance.
